commit.message:
agentHost: add a read-only built-in Ask agent for Copilot (#340866)

* agentHost: add a read-only built-in Ask agent for Copilot

Adds a built-in Ask agent to Copilot Agent Host sessions. The old harness had an Ask mode that could
only read the workspace. Users missed it after the move to the Copilot SDK. The SDK enforces the
custom agent tools list as an allow-list, so Ask cannot use tools that write files or run commands.

- Adds a registry of built-in Copilot agents in copilotBuiltinAgents.ts. Ask is the first entry.
  Other code uses the registry and does not refer to Ask directly.
- Serves each built-in agent as a read-only .agent.md file on a host in-memory file system
  (copilot-builtin:). Clients read it through the usual resource path, so they need no special
  URI handling.
- Gives Ask only read-only tools: view, grep, glob, rg, lsp, web fetch and search, ask_user,
  and client tools marked with readOnlyHint. Ask gets no shell, edit, subagent, or MCP tools.
- Registers built-in agents for each non-ephemeral session, so a user can select Ask during a
  session. A user agent with the same SDK name cannot replace a built-in agent.
- Uses ICustomAgent.id as the CustomChatMode id. Before, the mode id was the client URI. For an
  Agent Host agent that is not a local file, the client URI is wrapped, so the pickers and drafts
  did not find the selected agent and changed back to "Agent".
- Sends the unwrapped agent URI in the chat/turnStarted message.

Fixes https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/339999

(Commit message generated by Copilot)

* agentHost: fix grammar in Ask agent prompt

(Commit message generated by Copilot)

* agentHost: hide built-in agents from the task tool

The Copilot runtime lists every SDK custom agent in the task tool of the default agent. The runtime
ignores `infer: false` for these agents, so the default agent could delegate to Ask as a subagent,
and the system prompt changed for all sessions.

- Sets `disableModelInvocation: true` on each built-in agent config. The runtime uses this field to
  hide an agent from the task tool. The SDK type does not declare the field, so a local type
  extends CustomAgentConfig. Users can still select Ask with `rpc.agent.select`.
- Excludes the copilot-builtin: container from the customizations integration test, as the test
  does for other provider built-ins.

(Commit message generated by Copilot)

commit.message:
chat: group image generations and unify artifact pills (#340799)

* chat: group generated image previews and unify artifact pills

Use one selectable preview and tool dropdown for image batches, keep reveal and save-action layout stable, and show generated artifacts through the shared editor pill. Preserve indexed original image outputs for live and restored Copilot results, with image reload and accessibility coverage.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* chat: preserve subagent artifacts and image tool block offsets

Keep subagent transcript artifacts enabled while filtering parent session metadata. Recreate retained image tool parts when approval changes shift their code-block offset, preserving registration order and expanded state. Add regressions for subagent identities, navigation, and approval transitions.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* chat: size image batches to the selected preview

Let each selected image or generating state determine the preview height instead of retaining the first image's size. Collapse empty previews and avoid duplicate cancellation and failure messages. Reuse per-image size hints and cover responsive layout, reselection, and the reveal-to-save handoff.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* chat: defer image generation UI until confirmation

Keep image tool argument streaming hidden and defer native Copilot readiness until the permission flow or actual image progress. Gate image animations and painting indicators on execution, including batches, and keep accessible/search/copy text consistent with the visual UI. Cover approval, denial, auto-approved generation, and runtimes without progress events.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

---------

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

commit.message:
agentHost: support MCP sampling requests (#340803)

* agentHost: support MCP sampling requests

- Use the Copilot SDK to run approved MCP sampling requests.
- Show live sampling requests as tool calls with confirmation controls.
- Save server sampling approvals in host settings for all sessions.
- Show prompt character counts instead of prompt contents.
- Cancel pending sampling when a request completes or the chat stops.
- Add tests for approval, persistence, cancellation, and UI routing.
- Update the sampling E2E test to decline the new confirmation.
